plugin_game_voice_description: She speaks to your teammates in game voice chat through a virtual microphone (VB-CABLE); your own microphone is mixed in too — just pick CABLE Output as the microphone in the game
plugin_game_voice_status_failed: Couldn't load game voice chat status: {error}
plugin_game_voice_installer_ran: The installer ran; you may need to restart your PC before it works
plugin_game_voice_test_phrase: This is a game voice chat test.
plugin_game_voice_state_not_installed: The VB-CABLE virtual microphone isn't installed yet
plugin_game_voice_state_running: Running: select CABLE Output as the microphone in the game and your teammates will hear
plugin_game_voice_section_desc: Her voice and your microphone both go into the virtual microphone CABLE Output; just select it as the microphone in your game or voice chat app. You can also ask her to set it up for you.
plugin_game_voice_switch_desc: While on, your microphone is passed through to the virtual microphone in real time. When Kotone isn't running, your teammates can't hear you, so remember to switch the game back to your original microphone.
plugin_game_voice_include_mic_desc: When off, the virtual microphone carries only her voice. While she speaks, your voice is automatically lowered by half.
plugin_game_voice_default_mic_desc: Some games (PUBG, for example) only use the Windows default microphone and don't let you pick one in the game. Currently: {mic}. Once changed, Discord and meeting apps use it too, so remember to change it back afterward.
plugin_game_voice_try_desc_system: The current voice is the system voice, which can't be sent into the game. Switch to DeepSeek, Kokoro or an online voice in {name} → Interaction → Voice and floating text.
plugin_game_voice_try_desc: Test tone: plays a 1-second beep and records it back from CABLE Output to confirm it works. Say something: says a test line to your teammates, who will hear it if you're in game voice chat.
plugin_game_voice_off_note: Turn it on to install the virtual microphone, pick your microphone and try it here. You can also ask her to set it up for you.
plugin_game_voice_push_said_when: She said something to your teammates through game voice for you; sentences within 2 minutes of the last one share a card
plugin_game_voice_push_said_what: Posts a card with what she said to your teammates, one sentence per line
plugin_game_voice_event_said: She said something to your teammates
plugin_game_voice_card_said_to: She said to your teammates in game voice:
plugin_game_voice_card_empty: Game voice pushes in the chat open here.
